description.en: Stylized trace-morphology concept using Hwang et al.2002 Uhangri Haenamichnus text/photos. This is not a specimen replica or producer species diagnosis. Small refers to hand-scale display planning, not actual Uhangri size: published manus/pes lengths are comparable and can be hundreds of millimeters. Our miniature0.36m slab, depth, exact pair sequence and color are artistic. Digitless pes is specific to chosen Uhangri morphology, not asserted for all pterosaur traces. Source preservation and authorship uncertainties retained.
